levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Presentation and write-up cover the plan's sections without connecting them to specific earlier unit work.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Presentation explicitly connects at least one part of the plan to specific work from an earlier unit (pathway, applications, health, housing, or decision-making).

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Presentation draws connections across multiple units, showing the plan as a genuine synthesis rather than six separate sections.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more of the six required sections (pathway, requirements, timeline, funding outline, support needs, contingencies) is missing or too vague to present.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All six required sections are present and specific enough to explain to another person.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All six sections are present, specific, and consistent with each other (for example, the timeline and requirements sections agree, and the funding outline matches the pathway chosen).

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Feedback is recorded as generic or absent ('no changes needed') with no real revision made.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least one specific, real revision was made to the plan based on actual guardian feedback.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The revision meaningfully improves the plan's realism or clarity, and the learner can explain specifically why the guardian's point was worth acting on.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Closing reflection is generic and doesn't identify anything specific learned across the year.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Closing reflection names one specific, real thing learned that shaped the final plan.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Reflection connects that specific learning to a concrete part of the plan, showing cause and effect rather than a vague summary.

lookFors: The funding outline stays at the level of general categories and approach, with no real dollar figures tied to household finances.
The presentation and write-up show a guardian genuinely participated, not a plan completed alone and reported after the fact.
The plan reflects real, if still general or undecided, thinking about the learner's own postsecondary path — it is fine for specifics to remain open where the learner prefers.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
